exposure: Third trimester estimated fetal weight (FW) centile (> 90th centile)
cohort: The study included 166 hyperglycemic pregnant women (39 with pre-existing hyperglycemia and 127 with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus).
finding: In hyperglycemic pregnancies, third-trimester ultrasound parameters such as estimated fetal weight > 90th centile, polyhydramnios, and cerebroplacental insufficiency (CPR < 1) are significantly associated with a higher risk of composite adverse neonatal outcomes.
